name: open-keep
description: Search, read, create, edit and delete your Open Keep notes.
long_description: Connects your AI tool to Open Keep. Notes never leave your machine: this extension talks to an Open Keep tab you have open, over a local connection on 127.0.0.1, and only while you have switched access on in Open Keep's settings. Reading and writing are separate switches, deletes go to the bin (recoverable for 30 days) rather than being permanent, and every change the AI makes gets a one-click Undo inside the app.

pairing_token.title: Pairing token
pairing_token.description: Open Keep > Settings > AI Assistant Access shows this. Copy it from there and paste it here.

port.title: Base port
port.description: The server takes the first free port starting here, so several AI tools can each run their own copy. Only change it if something else on your machine already uses 8420-8424.

tools.name: list_all_notes
tools.description: List all of your notes as summaries (title, tags, pinned/archived, timestamps). Excludes notes in the bin.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search your notes by text, matched against title and content.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of one note by id.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Replace the title and/or content of an existing note. The previous version is kept for one-click Undo.

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Add text to the end of an existing note.

tools.name: prepend_to_note
tools.description: Add text to the beginning of an existing note.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Move a note to the bin. Recoverable for 30 days, same as deleting by hand. Never deletes permanently.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every tag currently used across your notes.

tools.name: add_tags_to_note
tools.description: Add one or more tags to a note.

tools.name: remove_tags_from_note
tools.description: Remove one or more tags from a note.

tools.name: rename_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag everywhere it is used. Affects every note carrying it.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Remove a tag from every note that carries it. Does not delete any notes.

tools.name: get_notes_by_tag
tools.description: List all notes carrying a given tag.

tools.name: get_tag_by_id
tools.description: Look up a tag by name. Open Keep tags are plain strings, so the name is the id.
